items.q: Eleanor Roosevelt, Mrs. Franklin Delano Roosevelt was there, and she was to make a speech later.

ctx.x: So I had this brand-new, tailor-made black suit on that night. I really thought I was sharp. And I'm playing. In the meantime, there's a guy going around with a camera, taking pictures. So when I saw him, I approached him and asked him what was he doing. He said he was taking pictures. I said, 'For what particular purpose?' He said, 'For any purpose.' I said, 'Well, I'd like to get a picture of me. How much?' So he told me what it would cost and everything And I think I had him make me three or four of them; it…

So something was going on, and the band wasn't playing at that particular time, and we were still sitting on the stage. And while I was sitting there... Eleanor Roosevelt, Mrs. Franklin Delano Roosevelt was there, and she was to make a speech later. But in the meaning, while this other person was talking or... I don't know what was happening.
